dialogues.speaker: Aramis
dialogues.text: Thank you. I'm so sorry, this should have been my job, but...

dialogues.speaker: Aramis
dialogues.text: There should be three posters and one signboard now stuck on rooftops and on the city walls.

dialogues.speaker: Aramis
dialogues.text: Please bring those posters to me. As for the signboard, you can just leave it here on the ground. I'll have my colleagues pass it on to the appropriate merchant.

dialogues.speaker: Aramis
dialogues.text: Again, thank you. You've really saved me.
